purpose: REQ-CFG-01 execution-environment identification evidence for the PROTOBASE-1.0 development freeze (docs/CONFORMANCE_REPORT.md). docker-compose.yml, prototype_stack/compose.yaml, the root Dockerfile, prototype_baseline/Dockerfile.bootstrap, and .github/workflows/ci.yml on the `master` branch are now pinned to exactly these manifest-list digests, not floating tags - the pin recorded here is the pin actually applied, not a candidate awaiting a decision. Before this freeze these were deliberately floating for development convenience (docs/DEVELOPMENT_DOCUMENTATION.md §10.1/§10.9); ongoing development against floating tags continues on the `develop` branch, whose copies of the same files were deliberately left unpinned.
correction_note: The initial freeze pass (git tag `dev-freeze`) missed prototype_baseline/Dockerfile.bootstrap's `python:3.12-slim-bookworm` base image entirely - it was not one of the six images originally in scope, so the bootstrap image's own base was left on a floating tag even though every other third-party base image was pinned. Found by project-owner review after the initial freeze. Corrected the same day by adding the seventh `python` entry below, re-running the full frozen verification battery, and cutting a new immutable freeze tag rather than moving `dev-freeze` - see docs/CONFORMANCE_REPORT.md's addendum and docs/DEVELOPMENT_DOCUMENTATION.md §19.4 for the full account.
observed_from: docker buildx imagetools inspect <tag> against the live registry for each manifest-list digest, plus running the resolved image to read its own version string directly (not assumed from the tag name)

mysql:latest.role: db service - docker-compose.yml, prototype_stack/compose.yaml, .github/workflows/ci.yml (backend-integration job's services.mysql)

php:8.4-apache.role: Dockerfile `base` stage - the actual base of both the `dev` and `runtime` published images

node:22-alpine.role: Dockerfile `frontend-build` stage - build-time only, not present in any published image (§10.8's --platform=$BUILDPLATFORM pin applies to this stage)

composer:2.role: Dockerfile `vendor`/`vendor-dev` stages - build-time only, not present in any published image (also --platform=$BUILDPLATFORM pinned, §10.8)

selenium/standalone-chrome:latest.role: test tooling only, never part of the deployed application (IMPLEMENTATION_SPECIFICATION.md §8's own framing). Used by .github/workflows/ci.yml's e2e job (amd64 GitHub-hosted runners) and as app/tests/E2E/docker-compose.yml's SELENIUM_IMAGE override on amd64 hosts
selenium/standalone-chrome:latest.resolved_version: 24.04 (selenium-docker project's own release tag; the bundled Chrome build floats within it by that project's design, not this one's)

seleniarm/standalone-chromium:latest.role: test tooling only, never part of the deployed application. docker-compose.yml's and app/tests/E2E/docker-compose.yml's default SELENIUM_IMAGE, for local Apple Silicon/arm64 development (§10.5's arm64 rationale)
seleniarm/standalone-chromium:latest.resolved_version: not labeled by the image itself; identified only by the digest below

python:3.12-slim-bookworm.role: prototype_baseline/Dockerfile.bootstrap's only stage - the base of the published bsc-thesis-icd10-bootstrap image. Added in the post-dev-freeze correction; missed in the initial pinning pass because it isn't referenced from docker-compose.yml/the root Dockerfile/ci.yml directly, only from this second Dockerfile one level down

deliberately_not_recorded.project_owned_ghcr_images: ghcr.io/junomarx/bsc-thesis-icd10:latest, :dev, and bsc-thesis-icd10-bootstrap:latest are built from this repository's own source, not a third-party dependency - their identity is the git commit they were built from (docs/CHANGELOG.md's CI entries already record specific confirmed-live commits/run IDs), not a version to pin here. Important consequence for reproducibility, stated explicitly per project-owner instruction: these three tags are mutable - .github/workflows/ci.yml's publish-images job overwrites :latest/:dev on every subsequent push to master, so pulling them at a later date does NOT reproduce this frozen evaluation state. The only reproducible path to the exact PROTOBASE-1.0 result is building from source at the frozen/tagged commit (`docker compose build` against the pinned Dockerfile/Dockerfile.bootstrap above), not `docker compose pull`. See docs/CONFORMANCE_REPORT.md's addendum.
